messages.content: 在壓力為10千帕的情況下，水的凝固點是多少？

function.name: thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point
function.description: Calculate the boiling point of a given substance at a specific pressure. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

substance.description: The substance for which to calculate the boiling point.

pressure.description: The pressure at which to calculate the boiling point. This is a float type value.

unit.description: The unit of the pressure. Default is 'kPa'.

message.content:
在 10 kPa（約 0.1 atm）的壓力下，水的凝固點（冰點）會略低於標準大氣壓（101.3 kPa）下的 0 °C。根據冰–水相變的 Clapeyron 方程式，冰的體積比水大（ΔV < 0），導致 dT/dP ≈ –0.007 °C kPa⁻¹。把 10 kPa 的壓力差（101.3 kPa – 10 kPa ≈ 91.3 kPa）代入，可得到：

\[
\Delta T \approx -0.007\,^\circ\text{C/kPa} \times 91.3\,\text{kPa} \approx -0.64\,^\circ\text{C}
\]

因此，水在 10 kPa 壓力下的凝固點大約是 **–0.5 °C 到 –0.7 °C**（取決於實際測量條件，常用值約 –0.6 °C）。  

> **簡單說明**  
> - 大氣壓下水的凝固點是 0 °C。  
> - 壓力降低時，冰的體積比水大，導致冰的熔點下降。  
> - 在 10 kPa 時，熔點下降約 0.6 °C，約為 –0.6 °C。  

如果你需要更精確的數值，建議參考專業的熱力學資料表或使用實驗測量。
message.reasoning: The user asks: "在壓力為10千帕的情況下，水的凝固點是多少？" They want the freezing point of water at 10 kPa. The tool is for boiling point calculation, not freezing point. There's no function for freezing point. We can answer based on known physics: freezing point of water decreases with pressure. At 10 kPa (~0.1 atm), freezing point is about 0°C? Actually at 10 kPa, water freezes at about 0°C? Let's recall: At 1 atm (101.3 kPa), freezing point is 0°C. At lower pressure, freezing point slightly decreases. At 10 kPa, it's around -0.5°C? Let's check: The melting point of ice decreases with pressure; the slope is negative. The Clapeyron equation: dT/dP = TΔV/ΔH. For ice-water, ΔV ~ -1.9% (ice less dense). So dT/dP negative. Rough estimate: dT/dP ~ -0.007°C per kPa? Actually typical slope is about -0.007°C/kPa. So at 10 kPa lower than 101.3, difference ~91.3 kPa * -0.007 = -0.64°C. So freezing point ~ -0.64°C. But at 10 kPa, it's about -0.5°C. Let's give approximate value: about -0.5°C. Provide explanation.
